node.label: Reduced tissue alpha-N-acetylgalactosaminidase activity
node.definition: Concentration or activity of alpha-N-acetylgalactosaminidase (EC 3.2.1.49) is below the limits of normal. The activity can be measured in multiple tissues including cultured fibroblasts.

evidence.snippet: Schindler disease, type I: Reduced tissue alpha-N-acetylgalactosaminidase activity [TAS]
